reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = Eurostat edat_lfse_03 pinned isced11=ED3_4 (upper secondary and post-secondary non-tertiary as HIGHEST attainment — the completed-secondary print, tertiary excluded), age=Y25-64, sex=T, unit=PC (pinned and guarded): 36 countries, the same per-country starts as tertiary (1992-era), the collector's b/e/p flags as-reported. No witness tier wired (the probe record); the world face is the Barro-Lee panel's secondary bucket, unwired.

notes: THE ISCED CHOICE, DOCUMENTED (the pair's definitional honesty): ED3_4 prints upper-secondary-or-post-secondary-non-tertiary as the population's HIGHEST attainment — secondary completed, tertiary excluded. The ED3-8 code ("Upper secondary, post-secondary and tertiary") is the at-least-secondary face — a DIFFERENT metric ~20 points higher; the ED34_44/ED35_45 codes are the survey's own recode variants; all three unwired, recorded in sources.yaml. THE WITNESS GAP: tertiary carries the Barro-Lee panel; secondary waits (the OWID door prints no secondary chart — the probe record); the world face of this board rides no tier today, the same honest shape the markers and consanguinity carry, with the future door recorded. THE COHORT FACE: La Défaite de l'Occident's 70-74 reads and Qui est Charlie ?'s c.1945 comparison are panel/book faces — the canonical's Y25-64 band is the LFS's adult window. La nouvelle # France's 1982 French census board is curated territory (book data). The M/F sex splits: one ref away, unwired.
